test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

__An ox on their tongue__ was the only way officers would have allowed him to carry on the unlawful activities he was involved in.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Bribed to remain silent."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"an ox on their tongue"** means that the person has a difficulty speaking, as if they were trying to haul an ox with their tongue.
 
• This phrase can imply struggle, difficulty, or a blockade in fluent speaking.
 
 
• **For example: **"The novice public speaker, nervous to his core, felt as if there was **an ox on his tongue **each time he tried to speak."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1". **
